geometry.locator: Beams-doc-1148 section 4.2, FSCS:XYH, "Geodetic coordinates at the origin A0"
geometry.note: A published coordinate, not a survey by this atlas; it is the point (100000 ft, 100000 ft) of the site grid.

method: Published geodetic coordinates used as given: Beams-doc-1148 section 4.2 lists the origin A0 of the Fermilab Site Coordinate System at N 41° 50′ 14.312704″, W 88° 15′ 41.143123″ (NAD83, WGS 84 taken as equal), ellipsoidal height 186.49880 m. The same document defines the FSCS "origin ... located at A0" and the DUSAF coordinate system "Origin - A0 ... Y-axis ... along the extraction line towards the Neutrino Area" (the Main Ring and Tevatron A0 straight section).
name: Tevatron A0 point: origin of the Fermilab Site Coordinate System

summary.plain: The reference point at the Tevatron's A0 straight section that Fermilab uses as the origin of its site coordinates.
